headline: Quiet day as earlier stories begin to fade
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Older stories continued to fade: Protector God, Gatekeeper and the endings that need powerful AI each slipped by 0.02, and the world factors drifted by similarly tiny amounts. Horizon Balance holds at +2.10.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.02 and Gatekeeper -0.02.
